channel.title: Maccy
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.description:
• Added VoiceOver accessibility.
  • Added drag and drop reordering of pinned items.
  • Added editing of pinned items inside the preview. The Pins settings pane is removed.
  • Added support for special symbols as pin keys ([];'./-=\).
  • Added image size to the image preview.
  • Added support for ignoring apps outside /Applications.
  • Improved OCR accuracy with automatic language detection.
  • Removed Safari WebArchives and other unselected pasteboard types storage.
  • Fixed memory leak of every history item.
  • Fixed slow menu bar title rendering with large history.
  • Fixed orphaned history item content not being cleaned up.
  • Fixed hang on macOS 26 caused by U+FFFC in titles.
  • Fixed hidden footer warning not wrapping in long translations.
  • Fixed settings window being too narrow.
  • Migrated to Swift 6.
